_doc: Per-variant economy. Every number is a hypothesis (design/EXPERIMENTS.md, design/model/pace_model.py); Step 06 tunes them with the real rules. cost(L) = round(base * growth^L) is the price of going from level L to L+1. A list (pops, batch, burst) gives what one action yields at level L and must rise strictly; it needs max_level + 1 entries. Times are milliseconds.

click._doc: A Click & Pop: one press = pops[L] popcorn = $pops[L].

perfect._doc: B Perfect Pop: hold to heat, release to pop. The gold window opens window_start_ms after the press and lasts window_ms + window_step_ms * L (at most window_max_ms); a release within near_ms of either edge is a near miss; an early release pays mult.early x held / window_start_ms (the heat reached); burn_after_ms after it closes the batch burns by itself. The batch pays batch[L] * the outcome's multiplier, at least $1.

explosion._doc: C Pop Explosion: each press drops a kernel into one of `slots`; a full chamber erupts for burst[L] popcorn = $burst[L] (paid when it erupts). The show lasts show_ms + show_step_ms * L (at most show_max_ms); presses during it fill the next chamber, which erupts when the show ends if it is full.
